summary: This stage executed a thorough static audit of the Paper P paper and repository without downloading the MUSE embeddings. It uncovered major implementation and reporting mismatches, including the use of LinearSVC instead of LDA, LDA cells failing with runtime errors, missing code for one-third of the numeric results in Tables 1–2, and definitional attribute vectors being shifted prior to MWEAT evaluation. It also wrote and ran a simulation of the doPCA centering defect and documented data-quality issues such as cross-gender noun overlap. However, it missed several key validity flaws, including the mathematical circularity of the mitigation, the omitted inanimate noun evaluation, and the masculine agreement confound in the word-pair translation test, which it partially endorsed.
